svg.aria-label: Isometric illustration of the Tcules Future Interfaces Lab. On a dotted floor stands a solid blue test bench with three interface prototypes under test: on the left a conversation whose answer is marked AI, in the middle a small app with a lime button ticked as working, and on the right a voice interface with a waveform. A Tcules person at the bench's front-right corner tries the voice prototype with a hand on its screen. At the bench's left end stands an open lab shelf with a flask on top, and a second Tcules person sets a faded, crossed-out prototype on its shelf: an idea parked as a dead end.
